# DSH Studio v0.9.22

## Changes and safety

- Preserve managed Harness precedence, import/require conditional exports, Profile extension fallback, staged startup qualification, prior-runtime preservation and unsaved-document guards.
- Test cold installation/full boot on Node 22.19.0 and 24.21.0 across Windows, Linux and macOS. Create one shared draft and bind uploads to its numeric ID; allow 90 minutes for Lite, Full and native recovery qualification. Repair Ubuntu mirror-list files and bound APT network waits.

## Fixes and polish

- Fix synchronous resolution-hook recursion on newer Node that stalled installation, repair or startup after `Node entered managed startup`, followed by the 120-second port-announcement timeout.
- Keep window controls above error/recovery overlays. Grant exact close-callback permissions, fixing `window.destroy not allowed`, and prevent destruction before hiding a running main window so its Harness and unsaved draft survive.
- Canonicalize macOS npm qualification paths, isolate parallel recovery fixtures and restore test Profile overlays after synthetic preset migration.

## Installation

- Upgrade from `v0.9.20`, then use runtime installation or repair to apply the updated managed startup support. Full/Offline and Lite packages remain available across the existing five-target matrix; Windows portable builds require the adjacent `dist/` directory.

## Verification

- Reproduce the old 120-second stall on Windows/Node 24.21.0, then boot the same Harness 0.1.7-rc.2 fixture in about 26 seconds after replacing only the resolver. Native cold installs and actual UI install/repair also pass for Harness 0.1.1-rc.2.
- Validate Full archive restoration/repair, failure preservation, signed updater downloads and rejection paths. The startup/window fix passed all 11 CI jobs. Local full regression includes 653 frontend and 562 Rust tests with 99.33% frontend line coverage; pipeline fixes pass 146 packaging tests.
- Exercise eight desktop routes, six selectors, native ACL/Profile/preset/session operations, long-session bounds, real PTYs, preference reload, Git review/retry and three Harness stop/start cycles in an isolated Windows WebView.
- Verify update-check completion, hit-tested window controls through error overlays, dirty-draft cancellation, tray hiding with service/draft preservation and clean exit after saving and stopping. External credentials, paid providers, Narrator and physical macOS/Linux interaction are outside this local evidence; publication requires the full platform packaging gates.
